name: Team View
description:
1. Reviewed the current profiles components and data model (`ProfileCard.vue`, `teams.js`, `TeamView.vue`, models) to mirror real profile fields in a new mockup.
2. Reframed the technical "profiles view" into a business-focused **Team View** for non-technical managers, mapping terms like `category`→Role, `content`→Persona, `tools`→Skills.
3. Designed a functional single-file mockup (`team-view.html`) with an app shell, stats strip, roster grid + draggable board, member editor drawer, and add/delete flows.
4. Mocked all data through a `mockFetch()` REST layer with seed members, teams, skills, models, simulated latency, localStorage persistence, and reachable loading/empty/error states.
5. Documented specs, accessibility compliance, anti-patterns, try-it paths, and next steps for porting the mockup into Vue 3 components.

messages.content:
We must convert the "profiles view" to Team View. The view is oriented to team managers to define their teams and members. It must be simple to use, business focused. The view will be managed by non tech people so interface must be user really user friendly, intuitive and easy to use.

In the view user will be able to see the members, arrange in teams, edit their properties and "persona" definition.

Review current components and create a mockup for the new team view @Mockups
